ambient_events: Water slaps the columns under the deck and draws back.
A cleat sits at the deck's edge, rope-scarred and empty.
Something shifts inside one of the loading sheds and settles.
The beam off the tower crosses the slab and keeps going.
description: Where the hardstanding gives out and the deck begins. A concrete ramp takes the last two metres up to slab level, scored across so a wet boot has something to hold. A lifebelt sits in a steel cradle with one strut of it snapped. The basin works at the columns underneath, and the pier runs NORTH from here.
name: Pier
